blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City is proposing a P15.74-billion budget for its 2027 investment program, with institutional development and management accounting for more than half of the proposed allocation ahead of City Council deliberations next week. The proposed Annual Investment Program (AIP) for calendar year 2027 totals P15,736,682,534, according to a resolution approved by the Cebu City Development Council (CCDC) and endorsed to the Sangguniang Panlungsod for legislative consideration. The City Council has scheduled the proposal for deliberation on October 13. The AIP outlines the city’s proposed programs, projects, and activities across four development sectors: institutional development, social development, environmental […]...
